// Package sample は Go の見本
package sample

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
)

type Shape interface {
	Area() float64
}

type Point[T ~int | ~float64] struct {
	X, Y T `json:"x,omitempty"`
}

const (
	A = iota
	B
	Pi = 3.14_15e0
)

var ErrEmpty = errors.New("empty")

func (p *Point[T]) Add(o Point[T]) Point[T] { return Point[T]{p.X + o.X, p.Y + o.Y} }

func Fetch(ctx context.Context, urls ...string) (n int, err error) {
	ch := make(chan string, len(urls))
	defer close(ch)
	for i, u := range urls {
		go func(i int, u string) { ch <- fmt.Sprintf("%d:%q", i, u) }(i, u)
	}
	select {
	case <-ctx.Done():
		return 0, ctx.Err()
	case s, ok := <-ch:
		if !ok {
			return 0, ErrEmpty
		}
		n = len(s)
	}
	raw := `raw
string`
	r := 'x'
	switch v := any(n).(type) {
	case int:
		_ = v
	default:
		panic("unreachable")
	}
	_ = raw + string(r) + "é"
	return
}
